prd.title: PRD-BOMManagement-v5.0
prd.summary: BOM (Bill of Materials) Management system for HPE. Enables users to create, manage, version, and export Bills of Materials. Integrates with IMDS Database for component data and LME Pricing API for real-time pricing. Supports GDPR compliance requirements.
functional_requirements: Create, read, update, delete BOM records
Version control for BOMs (track changes over time)
Line item management within BOMs (add, edit, remove components)
Import BOM data (file upload via S3)
Search and filter BOMs and components
Integration with IMDS Database for component/material data
Integration with LME Pricing API for real-time commodity pricing
Audit trail / change history for BOMs
GDPR-compliant data handling (data export, deletion on request)
non_functional_requirements: Secure authentication (username + password with JWT tokens)
Scalable containerised deployment on AWS ECS
Availability and reliability targets per PRD

integrations.name: IMDS Database
integrations.purpose: Source of component and material data for BOM line items

integrations.name: LME Pricing API
integrations.purpose: Real-time commodity/material pricing for BOM costing

authentication.notes: Username + password for initial login; JWT tokens for frontend to backend API authentication
